content: Truth is a pathless land, and you cannot approach it by any path whatsoever, by any religion, by any sect.
author: Jiddu Krishnamurti
sourceWork: Dissolution of the Order of the Star Speech (Ommen, 1929)
explanation:
In one of the most radical declarations in spiritual history, Krishnamurti dissolved the worldwide organization built around him, refusing the mantle of guru. Truth is not a static destination sitting at the end of a pre-paved highway of rituals, dogmas, or institutional creeds. Because reality is alive, moving, and immediate, any attempt to reach it through second-hand formulas only traps the mind in psychological conditioning.

Truth is discovered only when all crutches are abandoned, and the mind observes itself in the living mirror of relationships with total honesty.
practicalInsight: Do not accept any philosophy or spiritual advice—including this one—on blind authority. Test every insight directly against your own daily psychological reality.
reflectionPrompt: What borrowed spiritual beliefs or secondhand concepts are you relying on instead of investigating your own mind directly?
